services.title: Interior Painting & Decoration

services.title: Exterior Painting & Cladding

services.title: Commercial Decoration

services.title: Preparation & Surface Treatment
services.desc: Thorough preparation including filling, sanding, and primer application. Proper prep means longer-lasting results.

about_pullquote: I do every job as if it's my own home. That's the only way to work.
about_para_1: Greg Davies has been painting and decorating homes and businesses across Newcastle for over 15 years. Starting as a sole trader, Greg built a reputation for meticulous attention to detail and honest pricing. Today, he manages a busy schedule of residential and light commercial work across Tyne and Wear.
about_para_2: Customers return to Greg because he listens to what you want, explains the work clearly, and delivers without the stress. He sources quality materials, takes pride in preparation—the foundation of any good job—and cleans up properly once the work is done. You'll find him straightforward, reliable, and genuinely interested in making your space look brilliant.

reviews.text: Had Greg redecorate our lounge and hallway. He arrived on time, did a brilliant job, and was tidy throughout. Charged exactly what he quoted—no hidden extras. Would definitely recommend him.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Needed the outside of the house done urgently before winter. Greg fitted us in quickly, did the work in all weathers, and it looks fantastic. Professional and fair-priced. Top bloke.
reviews.author: Sarah J.

reviews.text: We got three quotes for redecorating the master bedroom. Greg's price was competitive and his finish was the cleanest of the lot. Will have him back for the rest of the house.
reviews.author: David R.
